title: Fused kernels in Triton
brief: Write RMSNorm, fused RMSNorm with a residual add, and fused SwiGLU, then measure the bytes you saved.
hints: One block per row keeps the row in registers between the reduction and the scaling.
BLOCK must be a power of two: use triton.next_power_of_2 and mask the tail.
Cast to tl.float32 on load and back to the output dtype on store.
